automationHelp.title: CLI Commands
automationHelp.body: Use the command line to check recording status or set a temporary recording area.
automationHelp.pathLabel: Executable path relative to the app bundle
automationHelp.access: CLI control is off by default. With user permission, set CAPTURE_SCRIBE_CONTROL_DIR at startup to a private absolute directory that does not yet exist. Connecting requires authentication and verification of the app executable, SHA-256, and instance.
automationHelp.limits: Starting or stopping recording, splitting, and transcription are available in the app window only.
automationHelp.command.selectionStatus: Read the selection status and authenticated instance ID
automationHelp.command.cancelSelection: Request cancellation of the matching selection
automationHelp.command.targetDisplays: Read display information last acquired by the app
automationHelp.command.targetSet: Set a temporary area for the next recording attempt
automationHelp.command.targetStatus: Read the temporary area and its status
automationHelp.command.targetClear: Clear the temporary area with the matching ID and revision
automationHelp.command.captureStatus: Read recording status (idle does not confirm saving)
exitProcessingQuestion: Stop processing and quit the app?
exitWaiting: Waiting for processing to end and checking its record…
exitRisk: Stopping, saving, or recording the result may be unconfirmed. Quitting does not resolve unsaved data or pending records, and owned processes may remain. Review the available information before choosing.
nextProcessingSettings: Changes apply to your next run. The active run keeps its original settings.
operation.busy: Another recording, processing run, region selection, or quit request is active. Wait for it to finish before trying again.
processing.request_invalid: The processing request could not be verified. Check the current screen and try again.
processing.request_duplicate: This processing request was already accepted. It has not been run again.
processing.run_mismatch: The stop request does not match the current run. Check the latest state.
processing.cancelled: Processing stopped. The source video and published outputs have not been deleted.
capture.completion_unknown: Recording termination or saving could not be confirmed. Review the available information.
exit.stale: The quit request changed. Review the current prompt before choosing.
runApplied: Run record saved in the recording information.
runPending: Run record saved in the outbox. It has not been applied to the recording information.
runUnsaved: The run record could not be saved in the outbox. Check whether it was applied to the recording information.
runArtifactLimit: References to published files. File presence does not confirm full video validation.
processing.record_unavailable: The processing run record could not be saved or applied. Confirmed outputs have not been deleted.
processing.storage_unavailable: Split & transcribe did not start because the location for saving its records is unavailable. The recording files were not changed.
processing.receipt_failed: The published file receipt could not be completed. The file has not been deleted.
processing.result_invalid: The processing result could not be verified. Confirmed records and outputs are retained.
processing.completion_unknown: Could not confirm that processing has ended. Successful completion or safe termination cannot be guaranteed.
captureSaveFailed: The recording could not be saved completely.
failureRecordSaved: The save failure was recorded in history.
failureRecordNotSaved: The save failure could not be recorded in history. This information is available only during this app session.
failureNoValidatedVideo: A successfully saved recording has not been confirmed. Playback and processing are not available here.
failurePlannedFile: File at the planned save location (not a recovery location)
failurePresenceLimit: File presence alone does not guarantee valid content or recoverability.
capture.failure_record_unavailable: The recording save-failure record could not be saved or read.
navCaptureDescription: Choose the screen and area to record, and set up audio.
navSaveDescription: Set the recording file name and save location.
navSessionDescription: Record your screen and check the recording status when needed.
navProcessDescription: Configure and run video splitting and transcription.
navResultsDescription: View past recording results and choose videos to split or transcribe later.
multipleProcessingDeferred: You can select multiple recordings, but batch processing is not available yet. Select just one recording to run.
historyNoDetail: Choose a recording to view its details.
history.selection_changed: The processing selection or file availability could not be confirmed. Refresh history and check the selected recordings.
captureStartTimeoutDetail: No start notification was received from the recording engine.
heroTitle: Screen recording and transcription, in one workflow.
heroSubtitle: Use the menu above to go to each setting or the recording controls. Recording history opens in a separate window.
displaysReady: Displays are available. Refresh displays after a display change if needed.
displaysEmpty: No displays are available. Check the connection and refresh displays.
displaySelectionMissing: The previous display is unavailable. Choose a display to record.
displaysFailed: Could not load displays. Check the reason and refresh displays.
displayPermissionHint: Automatic discovery does not open a permission dialog. Check the required access in System Settings, then return and refresh displays.
regionRequired: No valid recording region. Use “Set recording area…” to configure it.
regionReselect: No valid region, or display configuration changed. Refresh displays and select a region again.
temporaryTargetNotice: Used for one recording start attempt only; saved settings stay unchanged. A failed start also consumes it.
temporaryTargetConsumed: The temporary target was consumed by one start attempt. The next recording uses saved settings.
temporaryTargetInvalidated: The temporary target was cleared because display information changed. Saved recording settings are now shown.
temporaryTargetSyncFailed: Unable to check the temporary target. Refresh its status before starting a recording.
temporaryTargetInvalid: The temporary target does not match the current display information. Clear it or refresh displays.
regionAudioHint: The video region does not limit system audio or microphone capture.
capturePixels: Video dimensions: {width} × {height} px (padding: right {right} px, bottom {bottom} px)
outputAlternativeDescription: Recording could not start at {width} × {height} px. {altWidth} × {altHeight} px is a candidate output successfully recorded with SCK during this app run.
outputAlternativeWarning: The entire selected area is preserved and scaled proportionally, with padding as needed. Fine text and lines may become less clear. This applies to this recording only; saved settings stay unchanged. Output is verified again when recording.
outputAlternativeAccept: Accept and record at lower resolution
capture.output_configuration_failed: Recording could not start with the requested video configuration. Working files are retained. Alternatives are offered only when a successful output has been verified.
capture.region_invalid: The recording region or display configuration is invalid. Refresh displays and select the region again.
capture.selection_failed: Region selection could not be completed. Your confirmed settings have not been changed.
capture.geometry_mismatch: The recorded video dimensions do not match the request. Working files are retained and will not be published as a verified original recording.
historyLocationHint: Recordings across save locations. Import checks only the selected folder, not its subfolders.
historyStale: Last confirmed information ({date}). The current manifest could not be verified.
manifestUnavailable: Recording information cannot be read at its original location. Processing is unavailable.
processingUnavailable: The source recording or recording information required for processing is unavailable
fileUnavailable: Not found at its original location, or unavailable
history.index_unavailable: Could not read the recording history. Existing data has been kept.
history.update_failed: Recordings and outputs are preserved, but the recording history could not be saved. In Recording history, try Refresh history or Import history from a folder….
history.storage_unavailable: Could not load the recording history because its storage location is unavailable. The recording files were not changed.
history.backup_used: Recording history was loaded from its backup. If recent recordings are missing, try Import history from a folder… in Recording history.
history.import_skipped: This item or folder could not be imported. Original files have not been changed.
subfolderHint: Leave empty to save directly in the save folder. Separate levels with /.
finalSavePath: Planned file (a number is added if the name is already in use)
createFolderOnStart: Folders that don't exist yet are created when recording starts.
capture.finalize_failed: Could not reserve the recording name or finish saving. Existing files were not changed. Check retained working files at: {path}
saveDraftContextHint: Recording can't start until the save location is confirmed. Your existing recording history is not affected.
save.subfolder_invalid: Enter the subfolder as a location inside the save folder, separated by /. Absolute paths, .., empty levels, and unsupported characters can't be used.
save.subfolder_link: Symbolic links can't be used in subfolders. Use regular folders.
save.destination_changed: The save folder changed during recording. Source files are retained.
save.clipboard_unavailable: Could not read text from the clipboard. You can also type the file name.
revealOutputDirectory: Show the destination folder in Finder
statusFallback: Select a screen and enter a save location and file name.
sourceSafetyDescription: The working file is kept until validation finishes. The source recording is not deleted automatically if something fails.
latestHint: After a recording is saved, its location and check results appear here.
trimTrailingSilenceDescription: Detect only fully silent audio at the end and keep the source recording
splitLongVideoDescription: Split using your duration settings. The source recording is preserved.
splitCondition: Split videos at least {threshold} minutes long and longer than {segment} minutes.
splitConditionOff: Splitting is OFF. Saved settings: minimum {threshold} min / interval {segment} min.
splitLinked: The minimum duration follows the split interval.
splitIndependent: The minimum duration is set independently.
splitRelink: Match the minimum to the interval (link again)
splitInputHelp: Whole minutes from 1 to {max}. Actual boundaries depend on keyframes.
processing.split_invalid: Enter whole minutes of at least 1 within the supported range. Invalid input blocks processing only while splitting is ON.
processing.split_timeline_failed: The split video's timing could not be mapped to the source. The source is preserved; outputs with unverified timing are not published.
processing.split_precision_limited: Could not verify splits close to {seconds} seconds. The source and any validated parts were kept.
processing.split_validation_failed: Split output validation failed. The source and existing outputs are preserved.
transcribeAudioDescription: Create one TXT from the entire original recording, independent of trimming or video splitting.
recognitionAuto: Automatic — follow the app display language
recognitionAutoHelp: Automatic follows the display language; it does not detect the language of the audio. A manual choice stays unchanged when the display language changes.
recognitionResolved: Recognition language requested for the next run: {locale}
recognitionActive: Recognition language fixed for the active run: {locale}
recognitionChecking: Checking language support on this Mac…
recognitionModelReady: The model is prepared. Availability is checked again when processing starts.
recognitionModelPreparing: The API supports this language. The model will be prepared when processing starts; first use may require a network connection.
recognitionUsed: Recognition language confirmed in the latest run: {locales}
transcription.locale_invalid: The requested or reported recognition language is invalid. The source and outputs are preserved; no different language is substituted.
transcription.capabilities_failed: Language support could not be checked on this Mac. Refresh the status, or turn transcription OFF to process video only.
processingAction: Processing while preserving the Source Master…
processPartial: The video was preserved, but some processing steps have warnings.
noDerivedFiles: No derived file was needed. The validated Source Master is used as the User Output.
emptyHistory: No recordings are registered. Select a save location or import existing history.
noMatchingHistory: No recordings match these conditions. Change the search or filters.
capture.recording: Recording. The file will be validated after you stop.
capture.finalizing: Finalizing the recording safely and validating that it can be read…
capture.permission_denied: Recording could not start because screen recording is not allowed. Check the screen recording permission in your Mac's System Settings.
capture.filename_invalid: The file name contains unsupported characters.
capture.output_required: Choose or enter a save folder.
capture.output_unavailable: The save location is unavailable. Check the folder and access permissions.
capture.output_exists: A conflict with an existing file was detected. Existing files were not changed.
capture.display_missing: The selected screen was not found. Reload the screen list.
capture.already_recording: A recording is already in progress.
capture.helper_failed: The capture helper could not complete. Any available source recording is preserved.
capture.stop_timeout: Recording did not finish in time. Working files have been preserved.
capture.report_invalid: Could not finish saving the recording.
capture.start_timing_invalid: The recording start time could not be verified. Working files have been preserved.
capture.validation_failed: Could not finish saving the recording.
capture.probe_unavailable: FFprobe could not be started. Check its installation and execution permissions. The source recording is preserved.
capture.video_stream_missing: The completed file has no video stream. The source recording is preserved.
capture.audio_stream_missing: The completed file is missing requested audio. The source recording is preserved.
capture.duration_invalid: The completed recording is too short. The source recording is preserved.
capture.publish_failed: The recording could not be saved under its final name. The working file is preserved.
capture.report_failed: The recording was saved, but its report could not be finalized.
filesystem.path_required: Specify a file or folder to show.
filesystem.not_found: The file or folder was not found.
filesystem.reveal_failed: Could not show the item in Finder.
processing.silence_found: Trailing silence detected. The derived video will keep the first {seconds} seconds.
processing.splitting: Splitting with a {threshold}-minute minimum and a {segment}-minute interval.
processing.manifest_updating: Saving processing results to the recording manifest.
processing.input_failed: Could not read the input required for processing. The source recording has not been changed.
processing.probe_failed: FFprobe could not read the video information. The source recording has not been changed.
processing.duration_invalid: A valid video duration could not be obtained. Check the input video.
processing.source_missing: The source recording was not found. Check whether it was moved or deleted.
processing.source_unvalidated: The manifest has no validated source recording. Processing will not start.
processing.resource_missing: A required application resource was not found.
processing.worker_failed: The processing worker could not complete. The source recording has not been changed.
processing.output_exists: The existing output will not be overwritten.
processing.output_missing: A processing output was not found.
processing.trim_failed: Trailing-silence trimming failed. The source recording is preserved.
processing.split_failed: Video splitting failed. The source recording is preserved.
processing.silence_skipped: Trailing-silence processing was skipped because silence detection failed.
processing.trim_validation_failed: The trimmed video was not saved because its video and audio timing could not be verified. The original recording was preserved.
processing.split_skipped_after_trim: The split was also skipped because the trimmed video could not be verified.
processing.trim_not_saved_after_split: The trimmed video was not saved because the split did not complete. The original recording was preserved.
transcription.empty: The transcript was empty. Check the audio content and file format.
transcription.no_audio: The audio data could not be analyzed.
transcription.unavailable: Apple Speech transcription is unavailable on this Mac. Check macOS 26, supported hardware, and the language model.
transcription.model_failed: The speech recognition model could not be prepared. Check the network connection and retry after a short wait.
transcription.audio_extract_failed: Audio could not be extracted for transcription.
transcription.failed: Transcription failed. The video is preserved.
transcription.helper_missing: The Apple Speech helper was not found.
manifest.unsupported: Unsupported recording manifest format (schema {version}). This item will not be loaded.
manifest.write_failed: The recording manifest could not be saved. Available recordings and outputs are preserved.
regionSelection.accessibility: Recording area settings. Choose entire screen or selected region in the controls. In region mode, drag inside to move, edges or corners to resize. Arrow keys move; Option and arrows resize. Enter confirms; Escape cancels.
